Class SessionTPTPManager

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.trans.SessionTPTPManager
public class SessionTPTPManager extends Object
Manages session-specific TPTP file lifecycle for isolated TQ test handling. Each session that requires TPTP regeneration (due to schema-changing assertions) gets its own subdirectory under $SIGMA_HOME/KBs/sessions/{sessionId}/.

    • withSessionCache

      public static <T> T withSessionCache(String sessionId, KB kb, Supplier<T> op)
      Runs op with kb.kbCache temporarily swapped to the session-specific KBcache for sessionId, if one exists. If no session cache exists (no schema- level tell() has been made this session), op runs against the shared cache unchanged.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the return type of the operation
      Parameters:
      sessionId - the HTTP session ID (null or empty ⟹ no swap)
      kb - the shared KB whose kbCache field is temporarily replaced
      op - the operation to run with the session cache active
      Returns:
      the value returned by op
